title: Intermediate-horizon momentum
summary: Rank that older six-month return highest first; no positive-return filter. Require complete formation prices, a finite current close and positive current volume.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: At the completed review close, measure the return between calendar month-ends twelve and six months earlier; January 2018 uses December 2016 to June 2017. Rank that older six-month return highest first; no positive-return filter. Require complete formation prices, a finite current close and positive current volume. Select up to 10 stocks and review quarterly in January, April, July and October.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 10 stocks. Signal equity / 10 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Long-only Indian adaptation of intermediate-horizon momentum. Calendar-month endpoints, not twelve trading sessions; the most recent six months do not enter the return score.
Execution stress: double slippage and reject one-price-bar fills. 2018–2025 return falls from 1209.07% to 904.25%; the baseline includes a questionable TTML entry on 5 October 2021.
CUPID contributes +20.557 normalized equity points in 2026 while the whole portfolio returns +8.34%; this is contributor accounting, not a portfolio rerun excluding CUPID.
Current Nifty 500-derived universe, not historical constituents: survivorship and selection bias.
2018–2025 influenced parameter selection. The 2026 comparison has been inspected repeatedly; it is not an untouched holdout.
Fractional adjusted shares and normalized starting equity 100; no account-size, market-impact or whole-share constraint.
Current proportional delivery fees applied to all history; fixed DP fees, dividends, delisting proceeds and historical fee changes omitted.
Provider adjustments, retrospective exclusions and terminal-close estimates limit executable interpretation.
